verdict.rationale: The first-party human-in-the-loop guide says that when a tool call requires approval, the SDK pauses the run, returns `interruptions`, and lets you resume later from the same `RunState`. That covers the core pause, approve and resume flow. Missing for 10: evidence of pausing for free-form human input beyond tool-call approval, detail on how the approve/reject decision is applied and how RunState is serialized, confirmation that the Python SDK has this too (the evidence cites only the JS guide), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
